I will say the size of each color is a bit on the small side and I'll have to get another once again soon but if you're looking for a good practice pallet this is perfect!  I provided a before and after picture.  I love the brush to apply it however for the blending

I'm new to contouring so this is good to start. The brushes are actually very good quality, which surprised me! As for the kit is cream and works ok for what I needed.

claims.text: Many reviewers find it a good value and a solid choice for beginners learning to contour.
The included brushes are frequently praised as soft and good quality, though some report shedding or a broken handle.
Several reviewers note the product is very small with little product, and some say the lighter colors don't show well.
Blending is a common complaint, with some finding it hard to blend and others saying it works with effort.
A few reviewers report poor pigmentation or quality, including one who found it useless on darker skin.
